scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:catalog && pnpm build:defined && vite build && node scripts/service-worker.mjs
scripts.build:lite: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:catalog && pnpm build:defined && vite build --mode lite && node scripts/service-worker.mjs
scripts.measure:aot: pnpm build && pnpm build:moon-wasm && tsx scripts/measure-aot.ts
scripts.test:core: moon test --target js && moon test --target wasm-gc
scripts.check: pnpm test:core && pnpm test:unit && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.measure:runtime: pnpm build && pnpm build:moon-wasm && tsx scripts/measure-runtime.ts
scripts.test:conformance: pnpm build && pnpm build:moon-wasm && node --import tsx --test tests/sqllogictest.test.ts tests/sqlite-expressions.test.ts tests/sqlite-float.test.ts tests/sqlite-conformance-*.test.ts tests/sqlike-scalars.test.ts && playwright test e2e/sqlite-conformance.spec.ts
scripts.audit:sqlite: pnpm build && pnpm build:moon-wasm && tsx scripts/audit-sqlite.ts && playwright test --config playwright.audit.config.ts && tsx scripts/check-sqlite-audit.ts
scripts.build:npm: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:moon-wasm && tsx scripts/build-npm-packages.ts
